title: One-pot synthesis of tailored Pd–Co nanoalloy particles confined in mesoporous carbon
material_description: C@Pd90Co10-6 | mesoporous carbon with confined Pd90Co10 nanoalloy particles (Pd/Co 90/10 at.; Pd 3.61 wt%, Co 0.23 wt%, ICP-AES), one-pot soft-template (Pluronic F127) EISA synthesis from phloroglucinol-glyoxal resin with PdCl2 and Co(NO3)2.6H2O, pyrolyzed 2 h at 600 C under Ar; Pd crystallite 17 nm (XRD), particle 23.0 nm (TEM)
source_location: main-09 (journal p. 87), Fig. 10a, series C@Pd90Co10-6 (red circles), highest-pressure marker
notes: archive: fig10a_Pd90Co10-6_highest_pressure.json; digitized highest-pressure point of the isotherm (25 C, only this point extracted): 9.163561076604553 MPa, 0.2704639982714849 wt%; pressure_bar = MPa x 10; marker is an open circle (caption: open symbols = desorption) at the absorption/desorption turning point; the filled-symbol absorption line ends at it and open markers are drawn white-filled over filled ones (visible at 4.2 MPa for C@Pd75Co25-6), so it is coded as the last adsorption point; digitized with colour tolerance 250 because the open ring is a 1-px anti-aliased outline; point count = 8 filled + 6 open markers (origin marker overlaps the C@Pd75Co25-6 origin marker); high-pressure PCI (Fig. 10a): manual volumetric device with calibrated and thermostated volumes and pressure gauges, stainless-steel sample holder with metal seal in a 25 C water bath; not named and not stated to be home-built (instrument_identified false); H2 6N purity; real-gas EOS (GASPAK V3.32); free volume via sample-volume correction from He-pycnometer density; metal loading = PdCo 3.84 wt% (Pd 3.61, Co 0.23 wt%, Pd/Co 90/10 at. ratio; ICP-AES, Table 1); C 81.81, H 2.31, O 12.04 wt% (O by difference; elemental analysis, Table 1); BET range: 0.05-0.3 (Section 2.3, "unless otherwise specified"); BET area (SSA), Vt (N2 adsorbed at P/P0 0.95), Vmicro (Dubinin-Radushkevich) and Vmeso (Vt - Vmicro) from Table 2; average pore diameter 3.5 nm = BJH desorption-branch mesopore size stated in text for all C@PdxCoy-6 samples (Fig. 5); Table 2 diameter column is XRD crystallite size, not pore size; Section 2.4: samples pre-treated under H2 at ambient temperature to reduce surface oxides of the nanoparticles, then degassed at "around 120 C" (duration and end pressure not stated); skeletal density: "measured densities of materials are around 1.6 (+-0.1) g cm-3" (He pycnometer UltraPyc 1200 Quantachrome), stated for the materials collectively; paper says PCI curves were measured twice with good repeatability irrespective of instrument, but shows one run and no uncertainty (replicates_reported false); uptake basis not named (axis "Hydrogen capacity (wt%)"); basis_inferred from volumetric default; area_same_sample coded yes: N2 sorption on the same named C@PdxCoy-6 material (N2 degas 300 C overnight in vacuum), the H2 pre-treatment is a measurement conditioning step; temperature printed as 25 C (298.15 K); measuring_lab_id from corresponding author (Matei Ghimbeu, affiliation a, university printed as "UHA"); the paper does not say which laboratory made the H2 measurement;
free_volume_calibration: sample volume from He pycnometry density (UltraPyc 1200 Quantachrome), temperature not stated
